upstream.revisionPolicy: Evaluation is pinned to this exact commit. Later Transformers main commits do not inherit qualification automatically.

materialChanges: Unifies distributed initialization into one named device mesh spanning configured parallel dimensions.
Allows pipeline parallelism and tensor parallelism to be composed for inference while continuing to reject FSDP combined with TP or PP.
Validates world size against the configured PP/FSDP/TP mesh product before distribution.
Translates pipeline peer ranks through the pipeline process group to global ranks for point-to-point communication and final-stage broadcast.
Applies pipeline partitioning before tensor parallelism when both are configured; multimodal/VLM support was explicitly reverted from this upstream change and is not admitted by this wave.

acceptance: Pin exact Transformers source 5474a55e920f358d8382f3ecd3377edca979baa1, torch version, model and tokenizer or processor revision, hardware topology and exact launch command.
Use fixed public non-secret small checkpoints or synthetic fixtures first; do not download or rehost weights merely for inventory.
Establish accepted single-process, PP-only and TP-only correctness baselines before evaluating combined PP+TP.

For combined PP+TP prove named pp/tp mesh dimensions, world_size equals pp_size times tp_size with fsdp_size one, deterministic partition ownership and correct process-group to global-rank translation.
Reject incompatible device_map with tensor parallelism, mismatched world size, unsupported MPS tensor parallelism and any FSDP combination with TP or PP.

Correctness precedes performance: measure output or logit parity within task-specific tolerance, stage-boundary tensor shapes and dtypes, no missing or duplicated layers, generation termination and cross-stage error propagation.
Only after correctness passes measure same-hardware latency, throughput and memory against PP-only, TP-only and the currently admitted SZL serving baseline using the same model and workload.
Exercise process loss, timeout, cancellation, malformed mesh configuration and rollback to the previous admitted Transformers inference path.
Do not claim multimodal or VLM combined PP+TP support from this commit because that support was explicitly reverted in upstream PR history.
Keep model qualification, provider routing, product defaults, deployment and automatic promotion false unless separate normal controls prove them.

deduplication.result: material new inference topology: combined Transformers pipeline and tensor parallelism is distinct from existing vLLM, AsyncGRPO, kernel and model-specific evaluation lanes

authorityChain.githubSource: exact Transformers mainline commit admitted for bounded evaluation only
authorityChain.huggingFaceProjection: no SZL model, dataset, Space or serving image publication is authorized by this wave
authorityChain.productRuntime: no a-11-oy.com inference route, model default or provider default changes until the Forge evaluation and normal product gates pass
authorityChain.proofEvidence: HOLD until exact-source distributed correctness and failure receipts exist; topology setup alone is not production evidence

alignment.claimBoundary: Combined PP+TP is a distributed inference capability under evaluation. It does not by itself prove faster inference, output equivalence, multimodal support, hardware portability, model qualification or production readiness.
